pages.title: Last Ring
pages.creator: velnova
pages.description: Survive five minutes in a shrinking arena in Last Ring. Move through monsters while attacks fire automatically, collecting dropped gems to level up and choose skills. Pair weapons with their matching passive abilities to evolve them, then overcome the two bosses threatening the run.

pages.title: Tile Pair Match
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Connect matching pictures against the clock in Tile Pair Match. Select identical tiles linked by a route with no more than three turns through empty space. Remove pairs to open new paths and clear the entire board before time expires.

pages.title: Hospital Inc
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Develop a medical business in Hospital Inc. Start with a small hospital, manage its operations, and invest income in further facilities and expansion. The idle progression continues generating earnings while you are away, supporting the next set of improvements when you return.

pages.title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build a roadside business in Gas Station - Stick Simulator. Refuel customers' cars, earn coins, and upgrade the equipment before adding a store, cafe, or restroom. Hire staff and expand the services as more traffic brings new customers to the station.

pages.title: Crazy Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Overtake highway vehicles in Crazy Traffic Racer. Choose from six supercars and three modes, steering through four landscape settings without crashing. Use replenishing nitro for speed and customize or improve the selected vehicle before returning to the road.

pages.title: Drunken Fighters
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Trade unsteady punches and kicks in Drunken Fighters. Play against computer opponents or share a two-player match on one device, using defense to handle incoming attacks. Try the Funny Mod settings for changes such as extended punches or kicks during the ragdoll bouts.

pages.title: Autumn Glam Gala
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Prepare three friends for an autumn event in Autumn Glam Gala. Create makeup combinations from natural shades or brighter glittering colors, then choose hairstyles and outfits. Finish each character's seasonal look before the group attends the gala.

pages.title: Sudoku Relax
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Fill a classic number grid in Sudoku Relax. Place digits one through nine so no row, column, or three-by-three region repeats a value. Use notes to record possible answers when a square needs more reasoning before the final number can be placed.

pages.title: Slime Attack: Puzzle!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Defend a tower by matching ammunition in Slime Attack: Puzzle! Choose the colored arrow box corresponding to an approaching slug and time the attack to stop it. Keep checking the enemies' colors as the next group advances toward the kingdom's defenses.

pages.title: Survival master: 456 Challenge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Complete elimination-style tests in Survival master: 456 Challenge. Work through challenges involving the doll and fragile sugar shapes, following each round's requirements to remain in play. Avoid the mistakes that end an attempt while pursuing more in-game prize money.

pages.title: Stickman Jump
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Keep a fast runner clear of barriers in Stickman Jump. Tap to make the character leap, timing each action before a direct collision becomes unavoidable. Complete the course's sequence of obstacles to finish the level and take on another jumping challenge.

pages.title: Digger Fighter in the Maze
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Explore underground passages in Digger Fighter in the Maze. Dig through dirt to uncover routes and resources, battle threats, and talk with characters who offer quests or help. Navigate the labyrinth's branching paths while searching for its hidden treasures.

pages.title: Puzzle Lab
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Clear a board without leaving strays in Puzzle Lab. Tap groups of at least two connected blocks to remove them and use placed bombs when needed. Blocks left behind cost life, so plan the sequence to finish the arrangement before all life is lost.

pages.title: Dress Up Run
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Collect a moving wardrobe in Dress Up Run. Swipe to guide the character through the course, gathering clothing and changing the outfit along the way. Complete the run with the assembled look and finish its presentation on the runway.

pages.title: Ludo World
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Race tokens around a board in Ludo World. Roll the die, choose a piece to advance, and work toward bringing your side's tokens home. Select classic or quick play and continue along the trophy progression as the board-game contests are completed.

pages.title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Assist Oren in a fictional emergency clinic in SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY. Use the available tools to remove foreign objects, close wounds, and monitor the patients' condition. Handle interruptions from Black while working through the care tasks for Pinki and the other arriving characters.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Transport Truck
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive fuel deliveries in Oil Tanker Transport Truck. Control the loaded truck through transport routes inspired by different continents, managing its position around the road. Use the driving keys to keep the tanker moving through the next cargo assignment.

pages.title: Harvesting Veggies
pages.creator: FantasyTalk
pages.description: Harvest a puzzle board in Harvesting Veggies. Drag vegetable-shaped blocks into the grid and complete full rows or columns to remove them. Meet the objectives shown above the board to clear the stage and unlock another planting arrangement.

pages.title: Twisted Rope
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Separate tangled strands in Twisted Rope. Examine how the ropes cross, then drag their ends into positions that remove the overlaps. Work through the arrangement one strand at a time until the ropes are untangled and the puzzle is complete.

pages.title: Brawl Stars
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Compete with evolving heroes in Brawl Stars. Choose characters such as a fire dragon, electric dog, or flower spirit and enter the multiplayer arena. Battle other players and develop the selected fighter through the game's evolution system during the contest.

pages.title: Escape the Horror Craft
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Find a route away from block-world ghosts in Escape the Horror Craft. Explore each map and complete its escape objective before the pursuing creatures reach the character. Use the movement keys, jump control, and mouse camera to inspect the next passage.

pages.title: Scary Pairs
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Reveal Halloween-themed card pairs in Scary Pairs. Turn over two cards at a time, compare the pictures, and remember their positions when they differ. Continue finding identical partners until the whole board has been cleared and the next level opens.

pages.title: Police Station
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Manage a growing law-enforcement department in Police Station. Move around the precinct, hire officers, and develop the operation from its initial small office. Work toward improving the district's security rating as the police network expands across additional departments.

pages.title: BLOCK MATCH 8x8
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Clear target cells on an eight-by-eight grid in BLOCK MATCH 8x8. Drag pieces onto the board and complete horizontal or vertical lines to remove the blocks. Keep valid placements available, since the puzzle ends when the remaining shapes can no longer fit.

pages.title: Snake Clash
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Grow a competitive trail in Snake Clash. Collect points to lengthen the snake and use some of its body to break tiles along the route. Avoid deadly spaces and destroy more blocks than the rival during the two-minute contest.

pages.title: Jet Fighter Airplane Racing
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Fly armed aircraft through challenges in Jet Fighter Airplane Racing. Steer the jet, fire its machine gun or missiles, and use maneuvers such as a barrel roll to handle threats. Choose among modes involving air combat, traffic, or pursuit for another type of flight.

pages.title: Mini Springs
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Use launch pads instead of a jump button in Mini Springs. Move the small blob left or right onto springs that send it through the stage. Choose the approach to each bounce so the character clears obstacles and reaches the level's goal.

pages.title: Boxing Fighter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Trade rapid attacks in Boxing Fighter. Use the directional controls to throw punches and avoid the opponent's incoming blows. Watch for an opening between attacks and time another strike to finish the boxing encounter.

pages.title: Five Nights at Christmas
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Survive nighttime tasks in Five Nights at Christmas. Explore a snowy forest, interact with objects, and complete the work required for each night. Keep the character warm while watching for the Snowman and the other dangers around the route.

pages.title: Instadiva Nikke Photoshoot And Date Night
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Create themed looks in Instadiva Nikke Photoshoot And Date Night. Match each photoshoot's clothing request to earn more likes, then collect cards that unlock potential dates. Finish the styling choices before joining the dancing activity during the selected evening outing.

pages.title: GBox ChessMazes
pages.creator: Alexander Baikovskiy
pages.description: Carry a message through a chess-piece maze in GBox ChessMazes. Pass it between pieces of opposite colors, using their permitted chess moves to build a route. Follow the highlighted options until the message can reach the castle instead of playing a conventional opponent match.

pages.title: Popular 80s Fashion Trends
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create four retro outfits in Popular 80s Fashion Trends. Browse the friends' wardrobes and choose clothing and accessories inspired by the decade. Give each character an individual look while completing the group's shared eighties-style makeover.

pages.title: Office Conflict
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Enter a fictional workplace firefight in Office Conflict. Move through the office in first person and eliminate opposing players before they shoot you. Switch weapons, reload, and use jumps to navigate the setting while competing for the match's highest elimination total.

pages.title: Truth Runner
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a themed identity during a course in Truth Runner. Swipe to collect items belonging to the chosen role and keep the outfit consistent through the level. Different career pieces and recognizable costume styles provide alternative looks for completing the run.

pages.title: Grinch Chase Santa
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Escape a wintry vehicle pursuit in Grinch Chase Santa. Drive Santa's ATV through frozen streets while the Grinch follows on a motocross bike. Steer with the movement keys and jump when needed to continue the chase through the road ahead.

pages.title: Super Friday Night vs Neon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Follow timed inputs in Super Friday Night vs Neon. Press the directional keys or on-screen buttons as the music prompts arrive, building points through accurate responses. Work through the available levels while characters perform against animated three-dimensional backgrounds.

pages.title: Guess My Sketch
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Identify friends' drawings in Guess My Sketch. Watch the picture develop and type the word you think it represents. Correct guesses earn points, rewarding quick recognition as you compete for the leading position in the arena.

pages.title: High Speed Extreme Racing
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Compete through three-lap races in High Speed Extreme Racing. Modify the car, use boost, and manage braking to finish ahead of the opponents. Share the controls with a friend in two-player play, then spend earnings on better cars for later contests.

pages.title: Noob Huggy Winter
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross a snow-covered forest in Noob Huggy Winter. Jump past dangerous slime and thorns while keeping clear of the bees along the route. Use double jumps to reach farther platforms and continue the Christmas-hatted character's winter adventure.

pages.title: Slide The Ball
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Keep a ball safe on a horizontal track in Slide The Ball. Avoid both end spikes and the shapes moving into its path. Collect the blue balls among the formations to activate their helpful effect and create more room to continue.

pages.title: Dalgona Candy
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Cut a chosen outline out of a brittle sweet in Dalgona Candy. Use the needle carefully around the mold, timing clicks or Space presses without breaking the shape. Complete the outline intact to finish the sugar-carving challenge.

pages.title: Spin Soccer 3
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a football through rotating platforms in Spin Soccer 3. Turn the level left or right so gravity carries the ball toward the goal. Avoid spikes along its route and judge the tilt before the next bounce or drop.

pages.title: Dino Squad Battle Mission
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Break out of a hostile dinosaur encirclement in Dino Squad Battle Mission. Move the fighter through the area and attack the opposing creatures blocking the escape. Keep responding to the surrounding squad as you work through the battle mission.

pages.title: Fourtris Saving Pigs
pages.creator: Eu Game Studio
pages.description: Lower a group to safety in Fourtris Saving Pigs. Move and rotate the falling blocks to form matching trios and clear the layers supporting the pigs' platform. Bring it down to the ground to level up, then continue working through the next arrangement.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Wedding
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare Marie and Louis for a celebration in Dotted Girl Wedding. Choose the bride's dress from pink, white, or lilac options, then add a veil and bouquet. Finish the couple's wedding styling to complete the imagined ceremony.

pages.title: Monster Underground
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Develop an underground creature in Monster Underground. Steer the small alien worm toward food so it grows, keeping clear of soldiers and military attacks trying to stop it. Continue feeding the monster as it evolves toward a larger form.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Remastered
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Remove matching picture tiles in Mahjong Connect Remastered. Join two identical pieces with a clear path containing no more than two bends. Open new connections as pairs disappear and work through all twelve levels of the updated connect-style puzzle.

pages.title: Rocket Cars Highway Race
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Race along busy roads in Rocket Cars Highway Race. Choose a vehicle, use nitro to gain speed, and maneuver through the highway contest. Spend the money earned from races on new cars or upgrades for the one already in the garage.

pages.title: Run Royale Knockout Ultimate
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Qualify through obstacle courses in Run Royale Knockout Ultimate. Drag to control the runner and compete for a place among the first three finishers. Only those qualifying positions advance to another race across the game's thirty levels.

pages.title: MX OffRoad Mountain Bike
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Ride downhill through rough terrain in MX OffRoad Mountain Bike. Reach checkpoints while crossing ramps, cliff edges, and foggy sections, alone or alongside a second player. Use the respawn control when the bike becomes stuck to return to a usable position.

pages.title: Sky Track Racing Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive a jeep across suspended courses in Sky Track Racing Master. Steer along the elevated platforms and control the speed before each turn or landing. Reach the final area of the level, using the brake when the next section calls for a careful approach.

pages.title: Fast And Furious Puzzle
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rebuild car scenes against a countdown in Fast And Furious Puzzle. Choose from twenty vehicle images and place the scattered sections into their matching positions. Finish the picture within sixty seconds to complete the timed jigsaw and improve the points earned.

pages.title: Zombie Squad
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Drive through an undead outbreak in Zombie Squad. Shoot zombies along the road while avoiding cars and obstacles that block the route. Upgrade the selected vehicle's weapon and armor, or buy another model, to support a farther journey through the apocalypse.

pages.title: Means of Transport
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Identify travel options in Means of Transport. Look at the current prompt and click the corresponding vehicle or transport picture. Continue through the choices to match the different ways people travel with their correct illustrations.

pages.title: Head Sport Basketball
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Play compact basketball matches in Head Sport Basketball. Move left or right, jump to contest the ball, and press the shooting control to score. Time attacks around the computer opponent's movement while working toward winning the match.

pages.title: Off Road Passenger Jeep Drive
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Carry out off-road driving tasks in Off Road Passenger Jeep Drive. Choose a jeep and guide it through the uneven environment toward the mission's destination. Keep control through the changing terrain as you complete another passenger-transport assignment.

pages.title: Draw Park
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Sketch a route for each vehicle in Draw Park. Connect the cars with their correct parking spaces, shaping the lines around the available area. Plan how the routes interact so every car can complete its trip to the assigned bay.

pages.title: Pixel Vehicle Shooting War And Turbo Drifting Race
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Combine vehicle combat with racing in Pixel Vehicle Shooting War And Turbo Drifting Race. Earn experience through races and drifts, then buy cars, tanks, or helicopters. Fire from vehicles or on foot while exploring the game's different driving and shooting activities.

pages.title: Real Village Tractor Farming Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Work a plot of land in Real Village Tractor Farming Simulator 2020. Attach equipment, plow fields, plant seeds, water crops, and harvest the results. Drive the tractor and its trolley between tasks as you develop the village farm and complete its agricultural work.

pages.title: Arkadium's 8 Ball Pool
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Challenge computer opponents in Arkadium's 8 Ball Pool. Aim the cue using the displayed ball path and pocket the required balls during rounds or progressive challenges. Choose between two modes and adjust the available settings before refining another shot across the table.

pages.title: Bloons Archer
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Clear protected targets with a bow in Bloons Archer. Adjust the angle and power, then shoot arrows to burst every balloon in the level. Break structures when they obstruct the shot and try to finish with as few arrows as possible.

pages.title: Birdify
pages.creator: Gamesdev
pages.description: Keep a bird airborne through moving hazards in Birdify. Press Space, click, or tap to make it jump, changing the rhythm to fit the next opening. Stay clear of the obstacles as their movement adds another timing requirement to the flight.

pages.title: Euro Truck Heavy Vehicle Transport Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Carry large loads between cities in Euro Truck Heavy Vehicle Transport Game. Drive the cargo truck along busy roads and complete the heavy-freight assignments. Manage the approach through traffic and parking sections as the delivery route leads toward its destination.

pages.title: Super Jesse Pink
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Recover a stolen crystal in Super Jesse Pink. Cross pixel-art stages, avoid traps and ambushes, and confront monsters along the way. Gather coins for extra lives and use the shooting control when the required ability becomes available.

pages.title: Sand Art
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw on a temporary seaside canvas in Sand Art. Move the mouse across the sand to write or sketch a design, building its details in the surface. Let a wave wash the picture away when you want a fresh area for another drawing.

pages.title: Dr Bullet
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Solve shooting layouts in Dr Bullet. Aim at the enemies positioned around the stage and remove them with the bullets available. Work through sixty levels, checking the shot's route before using another round of the limited ammunition.

pages.title: Cowboy Catch Up
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Run through hostile territory in Cowboy Catch Up. Jump past obstacles, shoot at enemies, and collect coins along the way. Use the mouse and directional controls to continue the cowboy's route while working around the threats ahead.

pages.title: Powerslide Karts
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Drive three different karts through stunt settings in Powerslide Karts. Choose a vehicle and map, then accelerate, boost, and use Space to drift or jump. Explore the tracks and try different approaches to their ramps and corners.

pages.title: Honey Thief
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Catch a sweet meal in Honey Thief. Throw the bear's boomerang at bees to collect honey, with successful hits bringing the weapon back. Missing a bee costs a life, while hitting a bird ends the attempt, so check the flight path before throwing.

pages.title: Gunslinger
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Keep tin targets airborne in Gunslinger. Shoot the cans before they fall, choosing the next target quickly enough to maintain the sequence. Use each accurate hit to prepare for another shot during the Wild West aiming challenge.

pages.title: Death Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Keep a vehicle intact during high-speed contests in Death Racing. Choose a car and mode, then steer through the route with nitro available for extra speed. Activate shields and health items when needed to support the next section of the race.

pages.title: Santa Giving Presents Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble holiday delivery pictures in Santa Giving Presents Jigsaw. Choose among twelve images and three layouts with twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Reconnect the scattered sections until the chosen scene of Santa distributing gifts is restored.

pages.title: Bike Parking : Motorcycle Racing Adventure 3D
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Complete two-wheeled parking tasks in Bike Parking : Motorcycle Racing Adventure 3D. Select a motorcycle and guide it through the city's driving areas toward the parking position. Control the approach carefully as the missions ask for precise placement of the bike.

pages.title: Snow War .io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Push rivals off a frozen platform in Snow War .io. Move with the directional keys and release them to throw a snowball toward the opponents. Keep your own character on the snowy surface while the computer-controlled competitors try to force you out.

pages.title: Charming American Villages Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore small-town scenes in Charming American Villages Slide. Choose one of three images and a mode, then slide sections into their proper places. Use the building and landscape details to plan which piece should move into the empty space next.

pages.title: Pumpkin Soup
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare an autumn dish in Pumpkin Soup. Follow the kitchen activities to chop ingredients and combine the pumpkin-and-onion mixture, working through the recipe's preparation steps. Complete the cooking sequence to finish the soup for serving.

pages.title: Sushi Heaven Difference
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Compare food-themed pictures in Sushi Heaven Difference. Search for seven mismatched details across each pair of scenes and mark them as you find them. Work through ten levels, checking the dishes and surroundings for the remaining changes needed to finish.

pages.title: ABCs of Halloween 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct spooky alphabet illustrations in ABCs of Halloween 2. Choose one of six images and select a piece count between sixteen and one hundred. Match the letter-themed scene's sections until the Halloween picture has been fully assembled.

pages.title: Word A Minute
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Create vocabulary under a short countdown in Word A Minute. Tap letter boxes to spell valid words before the minute expires. Keep scanning for another combination and continue through the game's ongoing sequence of word-finding levels.

pages.title: Superwomen Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Put together illustrated heroine scenes in Superwomen Jigsaw. Select one of twelve pictures and an easy, medium, or hard layout containing twenty-five, forty-nine, or one hundred pieces. Reconnect the matching sections to restore the selected character image.

pages.title: Trash Cat
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Run through a cluttered road in Trash Cat. Jump, crouch, or move sideways to navigate the route while collecting bones and fish. Spend the gathered pickups on props and character appearances to use during later running attempts.

pages.title: Scatty Maps Europe
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Rebuild a continent in Scatty Maps Europe. Drag the scattered country shapes into their correct geographical positions and complete the European map. Work quickly while avoiding mistaken placements, using the neighboring borders to guide each choice.

pages.title: Words Block
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Arrange letter pieces in Words Block. Move each block into the correct position to build the requested words, checking how its letters fit the remaining spaces. Continue adjusting the layout until every part forms the completed answer.

pages.title: The Bowling Club
pages.creator: Super Appli
pages.description: Compete across ten frames in The Bowling Club. Flick upward for a straight delivery or draw a curved motion to send a hooked ball toward the pins. Pursue strikes and spares, using a special item to retry an unfortunate gutter throw when available.

pages.title: Legendary Sniper
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take long-range assignments in Legendary Sniper. Use the right mouse button to aim, then fire with the left when the target is lined up. Complete the different missions and watch the killcam feedback produced during the sniper encounters.

pages.title: EG Ninja Endless
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Collect valuables along a dangerous route in EG Ninja Endless. Guide the ninja through jumps, thorns, and bombs while gathering coins, gold, and jewels. Keep the run going by reading the next hazard before committing to another leap.

pages.title: EG Zombies War
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Deploy a military line in EG Zombies War. Position rifle troops, snipers, and rocket commandos to stop an undead invasion across the desert. Balance the soldiers' locations so the advancing groups face enough firepower before they break through the last stand.

pages.title: Motorbike Trials
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride across obstacle routes in Motorbike Trials. Choose a motorcycle and use the driving keys to balance its movement through the course. Pass checkpoints, apply a boost with Shift when useful, and reach the finish to complete the current level.

pages.title: Bounce Master
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Launch a small penguin across the landscape in Bounce Master. Control a polar bear's bat to begin the flight, then use bounces to extend the distance traveled. Try another strike to improve how far the penguin reaches during the next attempt.

pages.title: Pixel Escape 2
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Keep a runner out of danger in Pixel Escape 2. Avoid obstacles and enemy attacks while collecting helpful items along the route. Gather coins to unlock different appearances or pay for a revival when an attempt ends.

pages.title: Smash Hit
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Break geometric targets in Smash Hit. Tap pyramids and boxes to aim and fire through the three-dimensional arcade course. Continue hitting the objects presented ahead while pursuing a higher score during the shooting sequence.

pages.title: Ladybug Leg Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help an injured heroine recover in Ladybug Leg Surgery. Use the game's care tools to work through Dotted Girl's treatment after an accident. Follow the virtual examination and repair activities until the character's leg-care appointment is complete.

pages.title: The Wisp
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a spirit toward its destination in The Wisp. Move through a hundred platforming levels on the journey to Heaven's door. Time the movement through each stage's layout and keep progressing toward the exit waiting beyond the current challenge.

pages.title: Aluminium Foil Ball Maker
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Shape a shiny craft object in Aluminium Foil Ball Maker. Work through turning foil into a ball and polishing its surface, following the activity's sequence of preparation steps. Refine the sphere's appearance until the finished metal ball is smooth and complete.

pages.title: Geo Dash 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Cross fifty geometric stages in Geo Dash 2. Time the character's jumps to pass spikes and other barriers along the platform route. Keep reading the next landing as the course continues, adjusting the timing to complete another level.

pages.title: Guess the Kitty
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Identify the correct feline in Guess the Kitty. Choose the answer that matches the current picture and continue through the quiz without selecting an incorrect option. Progress farther to discover the game's ten possible endings and their different outcomes for the character.

pages.title: Basic Parity
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Equalize a small grid in Basic Parity. Move the selected position around a three-by-three board, increasing the number you land on by one each time. Plan the route so all nine cells eventually display the same value.

pages.title: Wedding Shopping with Bridesmaids
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare a wedding party in Wedding Shopping with Bridesmaids. Join the bride and her friends to choose a dress, shoes, and accessories. Once the bridal look is finished, select coordinating outfits for the bridesmaids to complete the group's shopping trip.

pages.title: 1001 Arabian Nights 5: Sinbad the Seaman
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Join Sinbad's matching journey in 1001 Arabian Nights 5: Sinbad the Seaman. Swap jewels into groups of at least three, clearing space to gather the treasure pieces required by the board. Use bomb or lightning power-ups when the remaining arrangement needs a stronger clear.

pages.title: Pet Salon Doggy Days
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Care for canine visitors in Pet Salon Doggy Days. Meet the dogs arriving at Pampered Paws and guide them through the salon's grooming activities. Use the available care items to finish each pet's session before helping the next furry customer.

pages.title: Cooking After Workout
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help three friends make a meal in Cooking After Workout. Join Elsa, Rapunzel, and Anna in preparing a salad after their exercise session. Work through the food-preparation choices and finish the meal with fruit for the group.
